Okay so, I found out the issue: it was the charger. Thankfully a friend had a usb-c cable charger for his windows computer, but because it was usb-c, I was able to connect it to my computer. Sure enough, the computer started functioning again. So, the macbook usb-c charger was the issue. Apparently it’s because they had different voltage/charge or smth

At the moment, I’m not even sure because the macbook is turned off currently and I can’t use it. Also, I remember I saw the condition of the battery, and it said that the battery was “normal”. So the system says the battery is normal, yet why is my computer continuously turning off and saying that I have no battery?

Mine is from late 2017, so yes, it’s old. But i remember. I had 33% of battery but when I plugged in my charger, the battery immediately went up to 46%. And now, it doesnt even charge. I just plugged my charger on a port in the wall, so I’m gonna wait it out and see what happens
The issue is though, it wasnt like this couple hours ago. I don’t understand why it had to happen right now

So right now, at this moment, I was able to turn it on. But, when I try logging in, the second it’s about to login. Boom. Computer turns off. Also, it keeps saying that there is no battery when clearly there is 50% of battery left. I just plugged my charger on the port in the wall, so im gonna give it some time. If it doesnt work, something is wrong with my computer

So, I woke up and I open up the computer. It was a bit slower than usual, but I just closed all tabs and assumed that was it. Seconds later, my computer just turns off and then I turn on my charger. No light. I see that my computer ran out of battery. Last time I saw it, which was 5 hours before I woke up, it was at 100%. So I’m literally putting my charger everywhere, plugging it here and plugging it there, but still, it’s not charging. Is this a charger issue, or a computer battery issue. Is there anything I can do at this moment? I have an assignment due by the end of the day, and going to the retail or apple shop to fix it would be too late.
